title: 29th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/29/2024).
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhangethi MP Abdulla Rasheed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A short sitting scheduled to debate the government's amendment to the Tourism Act and vote on anything ready.
